shepp_logan_3d — TOMOGRAPHY ct_scan op

• データ種: なし → voxel(引数だけで決まる op —— 画像やデータの入力を取らない)

• 呼び出し: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.shepp_logan_3d(size=128, supersample=2) (実装を直接呼ぶなら import ctscan; ctscan.shepp_logan_3d(size=128, supersample=2)、台帳から引くなら opstomography.get("shepp_logan_3d"))

• GPU: なし(CPU 参照実装のみ)

使い方

The modified 3-D Shepp-Logan head phantom on a size-cube.

The in-plane ellipses are those of tomography.SHEPP_LOGAN, with extents along z, so a CT reconstruction has an exact volume to be measured against, and ellipsoid_projections has the exact data for it.

:param size: edge of the cube, 2 .. 1024; or (Z, Y, X). :param supersample: anti-alias factor per axis, 1 .. 4. :returns: float64 volume spanning [0, 1]. :raises ValueError: on an oversized grid.
